label: sparse, unexplained token-conjunction feature (no clean predicate)
explanation: Very sparse (0.017% of steps, ~1.9k sequences), weak magnitude (mean 0.125, max 0.239). Never fires at t<3. Activations are spread over all phases: copy 62% of mass, original 29%, delimiter 9%. The strongest single-variable lifts are modest: in_tok e/y/s (3-8x), out_tok y/a/g/p/t (6-8x), next_out g/p/o (6-11x), prev_tok i/m/b/w (3.5-4.6x), and L=3 (8x). No combination gets precision above about 0.5%: next_out in {g,p,o} covers 41% of activations at 0.13% precision; in_tok in {e,y,s} covers 50% at 0.09%; a conjunction of out_tok and next_out sets reaches 0.55% precision at 19% recall. The feature looks like a rare conjunction of hidden-state token identities that per-step and history variables cannot express. Magnitude was flat across the quartiles I checked for every candidate predicate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=y (+4.30), out_tok=y (+3.39), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+3.19), out_tok=a (+3.05), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+3.03), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+2.88). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.76), in_tok=g (-2.60), orig_idx=-1 (-1.64).
